**Combining all conditions:** From $n=2,8$: $p\equiv 1\pmod{8}$. From $n=3,9$: $p\equiv 1\pmod{3}$. Together: $p\equiv 1\pmod{24}$ (which also kills $n=6$'s $p\equiv 7\pmod{24}$ branch). $$p \equiv 1 \pmod{24}, \quad p \equiv 1 \text{ or } 4 \pmod{5}, \quad p \equiv 1, 2, \text{ or } 4 \pmod{7}.$$
